cases.prompt: Fix a local documentation typo and verify the changed surface.
cases.baseline_observation: Known local owner and cheap distinction.

cases.prompt: Fix a reproduced local bug with a known root cause.
cases.baseline_observation: Reproduction already supports the owner seam.

cases.prompt: Diagnose an unexplained local failure before changing code.
cases.baseline_observation: Root cause is not supported.

cases.prompt: Clarify a materially underdefined feature outcome.
cases.baseline_observation: Several material outcomes remain viable.

cases.prompt: Close an autonomous request whose material intent is missing.
cases.baseline_observation: Safe defaults cannot decide material behavior.

cases.prompt: Produce a resumable implementation handoff before edits.
cases.baseline_observation: The user requested a durable plan.

cases.prompt: Continue a local change while preserving dirty concurrent work.
cases.baseline_observation: The base must be snapshotted and scoped.

cases.prompt: Audit architecture without edits.
cases.baseline_observation: Read-only coverage is sufficient.

cases.prompt: Change a public API with compatibility proof.
cases.baseline_observation: Public consumers create a durable boundary.

cases.prompt: Migrate a schema with rollout and rollback.
cases.baseline_observation: Migration spans durable release boundaries.

cases.prompt: Change an upload boundary with security negatives.
cases.baseline_observation: Security and external effects require explicit gates.

cases.prompt: Diagnose a failure visible only through an installed plugin.
cases.baseline_observation: Installed provenance and diagnosis are both required.

cases.prompt: Modify plugin source without installing or publishing.
cases.baseline_observation: Source/package proof is required; installed proof is not implied.

cases.prompt: Diagnose a browser runtime defect with observable DOM evidence.
cases.baseline_observation: Root cause is unknown and browser evidence is required.

cases.prompt: Optimize a measured hot path while preserving parity.
cases.baseline_observation: Baseline, noise, and parity gates are material.

cases.prompt: Trace a routine change without upgrading proof.
cases.baseline_observation: M1 records the Direct route.

cases.prompt: Make a local change whose canonical verifier is a slow external job.
cases.baseline_observation: One non-shareable bottleneck makes fanout wasteful.

cases.prompt: Run three independent read-only audits with durable reports.
cases.baseline_observation: Read slices are independent and resumable.

cases.prompt: Coordinate three isolated writers against shared schema state.
cases.baseline_observation: Writers isolate but durable controller state is required.

cases.prompt: Recover repository content with destructive options bounded by approval.
cases.baseline_observation: Recovery and approval are explicit.

cases.prompt: Resolve a merge conflict without auto-continue or commit.
cases.baseline_observation: Conflict recovery precedes ordinary implementation.

cases.prompt: Run a resumable runtime stability repair loop.
cases.baseline_observation: Repeated runtime evidence needs durable state.

cases.prompt: Autonomously close a resumable machine-verifiable local change.
cases.baseline_observation: All safety conditions hold and resume value exceeds tax.

cases.prompt: Request closure for a routine task with no closure value boundary.
cases.baseline_observation: Framework state has no justified value.

cases.prompt: Request closure while the required environment is unavailable.
cases.baseline_observation: The environment cannot support a truthful verifier.

cases.prompt: Compare two implementation strategies for one write slice.
cases.baseline_observation: Strategy search is valuable but not delegation.

cases.prompt: Execute three disjoint write slices under one strategy.
cases.baseline_observation: Writable delegation is useful without a candidate portfolio.
